title: Evaluation of Sort Recovery via Rmax
author: Perez‐Gonzalez, Lopes, et al.
materials: 1× phosphate‐buffered saline (PBS; ThermoFisher, cat. no. A1286301)
BD CaliBRITETM beads: BD CaliBRITETM 2 colors (cat. no. 349502); BD CaliBRITETM 3‐colors (cat. no. 340486); and BD CaliBRITETM APC Beads (cat. no. 340487)
Detergent‐based cleaning solution such as CoulterClenz (Beckman Coulter, cat. no. 8448222) or 10% CONTRAD (Decon Labs, cat. no. 1002)
7 × 5‐ml round‐bottom tubes polypropylene (Becton Dickinson GmbH, cat. no. 352063)

steps.title: Prepare fluorescent bead mixture
steps.instruction: Mix two different fluorescent bead populations (e.g., CaliBRITE™ beads) to serve as bright target and non‑target particles; avoid using blank beads.

steps.title: Block plastic tubes with BSA
steps.instruction: Prepare a 2 %–5 % BSA solution in PBS. Fill each plastic tube to at least one‑third of its capacity (or fill completely for other containers). Roll‑rotate the tubes on a rotary shaker overnight at 4 °C using sterile technique.

substeps.instruction: Add solution to tubes (≥ 1/3 volume or full).
Rotate overnight at 4 °C on a shaker.

steps.title: Prepare cell/bead suspension
steps.instruction: Combine the cell suspension with the bead mixture in sort buffer, add 1–5 mM EDTA, pre‑incubate 30 min with 100 µg ml⁻¹ DNase I (maintain 25–50 µg ml⁻¹ DNase I during the sort), and filter through a 35‑ or 50‑µm mesh appropriate for the nozzle.

substeps.instruction: Add 1–5 mM EDTA to the buffer.
Pre‑incubate 30 min with 100 µg ml⁻¹ DNase I.
Keep DNase I at 25–50 µg ml⁻¹ throughout the sort.
Pass the suspension through a 35‑ or 50‑µm mesh.

steps.title: Inspect and assess sample quality
steps.instruction: Examine the suspension under a microscope to confirm monodisperse cells/particles; evaluate total cell number and viability with trypan blue or another viability dye; assess debris and increase wash steps if debris is excessive.

substeps.instruction: Count cells and assess viability with trypan blue or similar dye.
Check debris level; add extra washes if needed.

steps.title: Configure sorter for Rmax evaluation
steps.instruction: Select a sort mode with a 1‑drop envelope, add 0.5 % BSA to the sort buffer, enable automatic sample stirring/mixing if the instrument allows (or plan manual mixing pauses during long sorts), and keep the sample well mixed to prevent settling.

substeps.instruction: Enable automatic stirring/mixing, or schedule manual mixing pauses.

steps.title: Set sample differential pressure
steps.instruction: Adjust the sample differential pressure to a value that does not distort the relative positions of target and non‑target events within the defined gates.

steps.title: Run sort and record Rmax
steps.instruction: Perform the sort with the prepared suspension and configured instrument, monitor recovery and purity, and calculate the Rmax metric.
